Path: an API a customer can call — external data used as its own objects | integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. The client unwraps the `{success,data}` envelope on all four calls, and the test fixture uses the wire shape

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/external/api.ts` ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the server answers the documented envelope; the client misreads it.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-05T02:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2.** The whole External Datasource panel is unusable on the stock showcase. The table list is empty, refresh shows no timestamp, Validation crashes, and import cannot be reached. The verifier measured it twice (VF3). It predates 17.6.0, so it does not hold the 17.7.0 release.
- **Direction.**
  - `external/api.ts` unwraps `data` once, at `jsonOrThrow` (about `:133`) or per caller, for tables, draft, catalog and validate.
  - `api.test.ts` moves to the real `{success,data}` shape, so the test fails before the fix.
- **Related:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#21788, the server-side import twin, lands separately. This card verifies the import dialog up to the draft read.

The in-flight objectui#11092 and objectui#11625 declare other `app-shell` files. The server-side twin, objectstack-ai/objectstack#21788, lands separately (triage `5986834770`).

Why `Clause-②: no`: the `external/api.ts` functions are not exported from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry. The fix makes the client read the `{success,data}` envelope the server already answers, so nothing widens. The dispatch fences any new export, prop, type member or i18n key: a route that needs one stops and reports.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11640, head `4779053`. It lands when every check on this head is green

`domain:ui` execution seat 1 @ objectui · `session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-05T03:49Z. Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report's prose.

- **Shape.** The PR is a draft against `main`, and its assignee is `os-steve`. Its first line is `Fixes #11628`, the only line with a closing keyword next to an issue number. `Clause-②: no` is on its own line. Against `main` the diff is 3 files, +315/−77, inside the claim's surface: `api.ts`, `api.test.ts` and the changeset. No panel component changed.
- **The envelope is read once.** `readExternalData` unwraps `{ success: true, data }` for tables, draft, catalog and validate, and the `tables ?? []` tolerance that hid the defect is gone. A 2xx body without the envelope now fails loudly and names the route, instead of rendering an empty list. That is the contract-first direction.
- **The refusal half rode this PR, as the dispatch allowed for the same envelope in the same function.** The old reader stringified the ADR-0112 `{ error: { code, message } }` object, so every refusal read `[object Object]`. It now uses app-shell's existing `readEnvelopeFailureText`, not a second reader. The 503 hint keys on `error.code === 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'`. The seat re-read objectstack `origin/main`: `external-datasource-routes.ts:383` sends exactly that code, and the route header (`:52`) records the rename away from `external_service_unavailable`. `importObjectDraft` (the `/meta` door) reads both of that door's measured dialects.
- **Tests.** The fixtures moved to the measured wire shapes. Red before, on base `api.ts`: 12 failed, 4 passed. Green after: 16 passed. The whole `app-shell` suite was green on the merged head. Live: the panel lists 2 tables, shows a snapshot time, validates 2 rows, and opens the import dialog on the draft. Refusals read the server's message and code. The 503 arm can't be reached on the showcase, so it is NOT MEASURED live and is covered by a unit test.
- **Changeset, sentence by sentence.** It is `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`. All three paragraphs match the diff: the four reads, the refusal text and the 503 hint, and the loud non-envelope answer. The `Clause-②: no` line is true: nothing is added to the package entry.
- **Left as noted, not filed:** the dev-only `MetadataHmrReloader` reload after Refresh catalog (`import.meta.env.DEV` only), and the `/meta` door's two refusal dialects, which ADR-0112 already records and the client now reads. Neither has a reachable wrong answer in the published console.

Landing: on all-green checks on this head, ready, then auto-merge into the merge queue.
